Method of Attack: Phishing campaign exploiting an XSS vulnerability in UPS.com to inject malicious JavaScript that loads a Cloudflare worker script, which then causes the site to display a fake download page prompting users to download a malicious Word document containing macros that attempt to download a payload.
Attack Vector: XSS vulnerability in UPS.com exploited via a specially crafted URL in a phishing email
Malicious Word document with macros prompting to enable content
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious URL with base64 encoded XSS payload
